entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Shri Ravindranath Chaturvedi - Advocate for the petitio
 Shri Ashish Agrawal - Advocate for the respondent.
Shri Lokesh Jain - Govt. Advocate for the State.

Petitioner has filed this writ petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India challenging order dated 11.3.2025 passed by Collector wherein Collector directed that no transaction take place in khasra mentioned in the order.

Counsel appearing for the petitioner submitted that in absence of any notification under Section 11 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, order dated 11.3.2025 could not have been passed under Section 11(4) of the Act.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Govt. Advocate for the State prays for short time to seek instructions in the matter whether publication of notification under Section 11 of the Act is made by Land Acquisition Officer or not.
List this matter in the week commencing from 28.4.2025.

(VISHAL DHAGAT) JUDGE AD/
